Send the install guide to your computer AI, or follow it on the computer yourself.

Follow https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/blob/main/docs/agent-quickstart.en.md to install Mika CLI or the Skill for this agent. Use the connection method selected on the phone: USB uses authorized ADB; Wi-Fi/private VPN uses the HTTP address and a private token file. Run connect to verify the connection. With only the Skill, use its bundled script. Do not submit phone tasks or print tokens in the conversation.
Run on your computer over USB or paired wireless debugging. connect verifies the connection. With only the Skill, ask the agent to run its bundled client.
Connect the phone and authorize USB debugging, then run this in the computer terminal.
Run on the same computer to forward its client connection to the phone.
The start command prints the address and token on the computer. Add them to your client and check that the request time above updates.

Add a Streamable HTTP MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:%1$d/mcp on this computer. Set the Authorization header to Bearer followed by the token printed by the Mika start command. Do not print the token in the conversation. Connect or refresh the tool list and check that the request time on the phone updates. Guide: https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/blob/main/docs/mcp.en.md
Copy the complete config to the computer. The preview hides the token.
Connect or refresh tools in your computer client, then check that the request time above updates.
Save the token in a private file on the computer, then replace /path/to/token in the command with that path. With only the Skill, ask the agent to use its bundled client.
connect verifies the connection. A successful request updates the time above.
